mechanism: Senna's cathartic effects may cause electrolyte depletion and dehydration, which can potentiate MAOI-related hypertension and increase risk of hypokalemia-induced cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor electrolytes and blood pressure closely; use alternative laxatives (e.g., docusate) and ensure adequate hydration if senna is necessary during isocarboxazid therapy.
